paragraph: Fiduciary Wire tracked 21 deals this week, 9 of them in wealth management and RIAs, ahead of private equity and asset management with 3. Atlas Wealth Management and Granite Peak Partners were the most active buyers, with 2 deals each. Prices were disclosed for 6 deals totaling $13.06B, led by Halcyon Energy's agreement to buy Redstone Midstream. Among RIA deals, Harborview Wealth Partners agreed to buy Summit Ridge Advisors, and Northgate Advisors and Pinecrest Wealth agreed to merge.
